name: mv-4
idea_origin: Mejora line, 29 Oct: v4 story rules (through ex-v1) plus the part of t13-read-v9 that improved the DeepSeek L1 bank (hidden social and time costs in the review months), without v9's global relaxation of the risk list
operator: mv-3 + one prose sentence in the manifest instruction: never end a reply with text only; every reply carries its tool calls
hypothesis: In mv-3 games the agent ended 0-15 replies with text and no tool call (the provider wrote its analysis and stopped, sometimes with the calls as broken XML text), each forcing a runner continuation (limit 20); cp-v12 had 1-2. A standing instruction against text-only replies, in prose (C59: prose in the manifest does not break the pair), cuts the stops.
predicted_behaviour: 3 of 3 DeepInfra probes paired; in games <= 3 text-only replies.
refutation: Probes unpaired, or games with as many stops as mv-3.
change: mv-3 -> mv-4: manifest instruction, after 'Never send take_action alone and never observe in a reply of its own.', adds 'Never end a reply with text only: until the run is over, every reply carries its tool calls, so put the decision in the take_action call, not in prose.'
notes: Evidence: lab/reports/mejora/README.md. No thresholds, titles or fixed answers; the cues are general reading habits written as our observations.
